code:
# Compile and inspect each stage:
gcc -E mini_calc.c -o mini_calc.i   # preprocess
gcc -S -O2 mini_calc.c -o mini_calc.s  # to assembly
gcc -c mini_calc.c -o mini_calc.o       # to object
gcc mini_calc.o -o mini_calc            # link

# Inspect sections in the object file:
objdump -h mini_calc.o
# .text   (code for add + main)
# .rodata (the "Result: %d\n" string)
# .data   (call_count = 0)
# .bss    (last_result, size 4)
# .symtab (add, greeting, call_count, last_result, main, printf=U)

# See final sizes:
size mini_calc
#    text    data     bss     dec     hex filename
#    1234     560       8    1802     70a mini_calc
description: These commands build mini_calc through each stage and inspect its object-file sections and final sizes.

steps.description: The commands preprocess, compile to assembly, assemble to an object, and link mini_calc.
objdump lists sections and symbols, including code, read-only data, initialized data, zero-filled data, and an undefined printf.
size reports text, data, bss, and combined sizes for the executable.

title: Inspect mini_calc stages
